title: New text models and OpenAI upgrades
summary:
Two new text models, three OpenAI upgrades, a crowded community Greenhouse, and some necessary tending of model routes.

Added `grok-large` for Grok 4.20 Reasoning and `mistral-large` for Mistral Large 3. The `openai` and `openai-large` services moved to GPT-5.4 Nano and GPT-5.4, while `openai-audio-large` moved to GPT-Audio 1.5. Several existing models no longer require paid access.

Community additions range from Chroma’s prompt-made wallpapers and Dreamframe’s single-file media playground to polimage’s image workbench and Splash Tool’s screenshot-to-layers workflow. The catalog also gained image generators, an image-analysis app, a SillyTavern avatar extension, and tools for making short videos.

New community listings cover native AI chat with Warden, translated chat with Heia, character conversations with Neuro Mate, and help phrasing difficult messages with T-Buddy CHAT. Writing, games, a browser sidebar, and a desktop activity tool also joined the catalog.

highlights.title: OpenAI text models upgraded
highlights.text: `openai` now uses GPT-5.4 Nano, and `openai-large` uses GPT-5.4. [Browse models](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models).
